description: Bookie Analytics Dashboard v2 - Player-centric analytics with Player Attention Score (PAS), exposure tracking, and actionable insights

userStories.title: Create PlayerAttentionService with exposure and P/L helpers
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service with helper methods for calculating player exposure, realized P/L, volatility, and overdue status.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `Booki/Services/PlayerAttentionService.swift` as an enum with static methods
Define `PlayerExposure` struct with: grossExposure (Decimal), pendingBetCount (Int), largestPendingBet (Decimal)
Implement `calculateExposure(player:bets:)` returning PlayerExposure from bets where status is .pending or .accepted and player matches
Implement `realizedPL(player:bets:days:)` returning Decimal — sum payout minus stake for bets with gradeResult .win in the last N days, minus stakes for .loss bets. Pass days=0 for all-time
Implement `volatility(player:bets:)` returning Decimal — max absolute daily P/L swing over last 14 days
Implement `isOverdue(player:ledgerEntries:thresholdDays:)` returning (Bool, Decimal) — true if balanceOwed > 0 AND no ledger entry in last thresholdDays (default 7). Returns overdue amount.
Implement `winRate(player:bets:)` returning Double — wins / (wins + losses), excluding pushes and voids. Return 0 if no graded bets.
Implement `avgBetSize(player:bets:days:)` returning Decimal — average stake of bets placed in last N days
Use existing `BalanceService.balanceOwed(from:)` for balance calculations in isOverdue
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Bet model fields: status (BetStatus enum: pending/accepted/declined/readyToGrade/graded/settled/void), gradeResult (GradeResult enum: win/loss/push), stake (Decimal), odds (Int), player (Player?), createdAt (Date), isParlay (Bool), market (String — contains market type name like 'Spread', 'Moneyline', 'Total'). Open bets = status .pending or .accepted. P/L calculation: for a win, payout = stake * (odds/100) if positive odds, stake * (100/abs(odds)) if negative odds. For a loss, P/L = -stake.

userStories.title: Add PAS calculation and PlayerAnalyticsSummary
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Player Attention Score algorithm and a composite summary model so the dashboard can rank and display player analytics.
acceptanceCriteria: Define `PlayerAttentionScore` struct with: score (Int, 0-100), label (String: 'Low'/'Medium'/'High'), reasonChips ([String])

Implement `calculatePAS(player:bets:ledgerEntries:)` using formula: PAS = 100 * (0.35*A + 0.20*B + 0.15*C + 0.20*D + 0.10*E) where A=normalized open exposure, B=normalized abs(7d P/L), C=normalized largest open bet, D=normalized overdue amount, E=normalized volatility
Each factor normalized 0-1 by dividing by a sensible cap (e.g., exposure/$5000, P/L/$2000, single bet/$1000, overdue/$2000, volatility/$1000), clamped to 1.0 max
Label thresholds: 0-33 Low, 34-66 Medium, 67-100 High

Reason chips generated from top 2-3 contributing factors: 'Large pending', 'Overdue', 'On heater' (7d P/L strongly positive), 'Cold streak' (7d P/L strongly negative), 'High volatility', 'High roller' (avg bet size > $200), 'Parlay heavy' (>50% of recent bets are parlays)

Define `PlayerAnalyticsSummary` struct with fields: player (Player), pas (PlayerAttentionScore), exposure (PlayerExposure), balanceOwed (Decimal), sevenDayPL (Decimal), thirtyDayPL (Decimal), allTimePL (Decimal), avgBetSize30d (Decimal), isOverdue (Bool), overdueAmount (Decimal), winRate (Double)
Implement `generateSummaries(players:bets:ledgerEntries:) -> [PlayerAnalyticsSummary]` computing all fields for each active player, sorted by PAS score descending
Handle edge cases: new player with no bets (PAS=0, all metrics 0), player with only pending bets (realized P/L=0)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Uses all helper methods from US-001. PlayerAnalyticsSummary is the single data source for both summary cards and player list. Parlay detection: Bet.isParlay field exists on the model.

userStories.title: Create AnalyticsDashboardView with summary cards
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to see 4 key metrics at the top of my analytics dashboard so I can instantly understand today's risk.
acceptanceCriteria: Create NEW file `Booki/Views/AnalyticsDashboardView.swift` — do NOT modify existing DashboardView.swift
Add @Query for bets, players, ledgerEntries (same pattern as existing DashboardView)
Compute summaries using PlayerAttentionService.generateSummaries() in a computed property
Show exactly 4 tappable summary cards in a 2x2 LazyVGrid at the top
Card 1 — Today's Net Exposure: total grossExposure across all player summaries, formatted as currency
Card 2 — Pending Bets: total pendingBetCount across all summaries + total stake of pending bets
Card 3 — Top Risk Player: name of first summary (highest PAS) + their top reason chip, or 'All clear' if no players or all PAS=0
Card 4 — Outstanding Balances: sum of overdueAmount across overdue players + count of overdue players
Each card uses Theme.cardBackground, Theme.font() for the metric value, Theme.bodyFont() for labels
Show 'Last updated' timestamp below cards using Theme.caption
Empty state when bookie has no players: encouraging message with icon
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Build as a SEPARATE view from DashboardView. We will swap it in later (US-011). This keeps existing functionality intact during development. Cards should be extracted into a sub-view (e.g., SummaryCard) to keep the body simple. Use @State for card tap actions (will wire up navigation in US-011).

userStories.title: Add ranked player list to AnalyticsDashboardView
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to see all my players ranked by attention needed so I can quickly identify who to focus on.
acceptanceCriteria: Player list appears below the 4 summary cards in AnalyticsDashboardView, inside a ScrollView
Section header 'PLAYERS' in Theme.caption style with tracking
Default sort is PAS descending (highest attention first) — already sorted from generateSummaries()
Extract row into `PlayerAnalyticsRow` sub-view in the same file to avoid type-checker timeouts
Each row shows: player name (Theme.font, bold), PAS label badge (colored capsule: danger for High, warning for Medium, textMuted for Low)
Primary metric logic (show exactly one): if isOverdue show 'Overdue: $X' in danger color, else if exposure.grossExposure > 0 show 'Open exposure: $X', else show '7d P/L: ±$X' with green/red color
Secondary metrics row (max 2, Theme.caption + textSecondary): 'Lifetime: ±$X' and 'Avg bet: $X'
Status chips (max 3 per row) as small capsules from reasonChips array with appropriate Theme colors
Rows use Theme.cardBackground with Theme.cornerRadiusSmall
Tapping a player row does nothing yet (NavigationLink wired in US-011)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Format currency using a local helper like existing views: `func formatCurrency(_ value: Decimal) -> String`. Use NumberFormatter with .currency style. Chip color mapping: 'Overdue' → danger, 'On heater' → gold, 'Cold streak' → accentTertiary, 'High roller' → accentSecondary, 'Parlay heavy' → scheduled, 'High volatility' → warning, 'Large pending' → accent.

userStories.title: Add filters and search to player list
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to filter and search the player list so I can quickly find specific players or segments.
acceptanceCriteria: Add search bar above player list using .searchable() modifier or a custom TextField with search icon
Search filters by player name (case-insensitive contains match)
Add horizontally scrolling status filter chips between search and list: All / Attention needed / Overdue / High exposure / Big winners / Big losers
Filter logic: 'Attention needed' = PAS >= 34, 'Overdue' = isOverdue, 'High exposure' = grossExposure > 0, 'Big winners' = sevenDayPL > 0, 'Big losers' = sevenDayPL < 0
Active filter chip uses Theme.accent background, inactive uses Theme.elevatedBackground
Filters and search compose together (both apply simultaneously)
Show result count label (e.g., '5 of 12 players') in Theme.caption below filters
Empty state when no players match: 'No players match filters' message
All filter UI uses Theme styling (font, colors, backgrounds)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use @State private var searchText = '' and @State private var activeFilter = 'All'. Filter chips pattern similar to existing sport tabs in GamesView — horizontally scrolling HStack in a ScrollView(.horizontal).

userStories.title: Create PlayerAnalyticsDetailView with header and Today section
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to tap into a player and see their current status and today's activity at the top.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `Booki/Views/PlayerAnalyticsDetailView.swift` accepting a PlayerAnalyticsSummary parameter

Header shows: player name (Theme.title1), current balance formatted and color-coded (green if positive/credit for bookie, red if negative), PAS attention label as colored badge, reason chips as small capsules
Two primary CTA buttons in an HStack below header: 'Add Bet' and 'Settle Up' — use Theme.headline + .textCase(.uppercase), full-width split evenly
Both buttons are non-functional placeholders for now (just print to console on tap)
Today section card with header 'TODAY' shows: open exposure amount, open bets count, largest open bet amount
Each Today metric in an HStack with label (Theme.bodyFont, textSecondary) and value (Theme.font, textPrimary)
Section uses Theme.cardBackground with cardStyle()
Wrap in ScrollView for the full detail view structure
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Balance convention for bookie: positive balanceOwed = player owes bookie (good, show in green/accent). Negative = bookie owes player (show in danger). Sections will be added below in strict order: Today → Performance → Behavior → Reliability → History.

userStories.title: Add Performance section to player detail
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to see a player's profit/loss trends so I can understand their trajectory.
acceptanceCriteria: Performance section appears below Today section in PlayerAnalyticsDetailView
Section header 'PERFORMANCE' in Theme.caption style with tracking
Shows 4 metrics in a 2x2 LazyVGrid: 7d P/L, 30d P/L, All-time P/L, Win Rate
Each metric card shows label (Theme.caption, textSecondary) and value (Theme.font(size:17, weight:.bold))
P/L values color-coded: positive green (Theme.accent), negative red (Theme.danger), zero neutral (Theme.textSecondary)
Win rate displayed as percentage (e.g., '62%')
Section wrapped in card style (Theme.cardBackground + cardStyle())
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Sparkline removed from this story to keep it right-sized. Can be added as a follow-up. All P/L values come from PlayerAnalyticsSummary — no additional computation needed. Win rate from summary.winRate, format as percentage.

userStories.title: Add Behavior section to player detail
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to understand a player's betting patterns so I can identify risky or unusual behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior section appears below Performance in PlayerAnalyticsDetailView
Section header 'BEHAVIOR' in Theme.caption style with tracking
Shows: avg bet size (30d) and bets per week (30d average) as metric rows
Shows market type mix as a horizontal stacked percentage bar (GeometryReader + HStack of colored rectangles)

Market type derived from Bet.market string field: contains 'spread' → Spread, contains 'moneyline' → Moneyline, contains 'total' → Total. Bets with isParlay=true counted as Parlay regardless of market
Bar segments use: Theme.accent for Spread, Theme.accentSecondary for Moneyline, Theme.gold for Total, Theme.accentTertiary for Parlay
Legend below bar: HStack of (color dot + label + percentage) for each type with >0%
Handle edge case: player with no bets in 30 days shows 'No recent activity' centered text
Compute market mix from player's bets in last 30 days, passed via additional bets parameter or computed in-view
Section wrapped in card style
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Bet.market is a String field (e.g., 'Spread', 'Moneyline', 'Total'). Use case-insensitive .lowercased().contains() matching. Bet.isParlay is a Bool field. Bets per week = (count of bets in 30d) / 4.3. PlayerAnalyticsDetailView will need access to the player's bets — either pass them as a parameter or add @Query filtered by player.

userStories.title: Add Reliability and History sections to player detail
userStories.description: As a bookie, I want to see a player's payment reliability and full history so I can manage collections.
acceptanceCriteria: Reliability section below Behavior with header 'RELIABILITY'
Shows: payment status label (Current / Overdue / New) as colored badge, days since last payment or 'No payments yet', overdue amount if applicable in danger color
Payment status: 'New' if no ledger entries, 'Overdue' if isOverdue from summary, 'Current' otherwise
Days since last payment: find most recent ledger entry date for the player
History section below Reliability with header 'RECENT ACTIVITY'
Shows last 10 bets for the player sorted by createdAt descending
Each bet row: date (Theme.caption), event description (Bet.eventDescription or 'Unknown Event'), side + odds, stake, and status/result badge
Result badge: green 'W' for win, red 'L' for loss, gray 'P' for push, muted 'Pending' for open
If player has more than 10 bets, show 'View All' link at bottom (non-functional placeholder)
All sections wrapped in card style, using Theme styling
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: PlayerAnalyticsDetailView needs access to player's ledgerEntries and bets. Either pass as parameters or use @Query with a predicate filtering by player. Bet.eventDescription exists for offline display. Bet.createdAt for sorting. Use case-insensitive UUID comparison (.lowercased()) if looking up events by eventId.
